<document id="account-documents">
DocumentsˆforˆidentityˆverificationˆToˆverifyˆyourˆidentity,ˆweˆneedˆaˆphotoˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie,ˆplusˆaˆfewˆdetails.ˆ##ˆPhotoˆIDsˆweˆacceptˆ-ˆUSˆdriver'sˆlicenseˆorˆstateˆIDˆcardˆ-ˆUSˆpassportˆorˆpassportˆcardˆ-ˆPermanentˆresidentˆcardˆ-ˆForeignˆpassport,ˆtogetherˆwithˆanˆITINˆTheˆIDˆmustˆbeˆunexpired,ˆandˆallˆfourˆcornersˆmustˆbeˆvisibleˆinˆtheˆphoto.ˆ##ˆSelfieˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆtakeˆaˆshortˆselfieˆvideoˆtoˆmatchˆyourˆfaceˆtoˆtheˆID.ˆRemoveˆglassesˆandˆhats,ˆandˆuseˆgoodˆlight.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆlegalˆname,ˆdateˆofˆbirth,ˆresidentialˆaddressˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆYourˆnameˆmustˆmatchˆyourˆID.ˆ##ˆProofˆofˆaddressˆIfˆweˆcan'tˆconfirmˆyourˆaddressˆautomatically,ˆwe'llˆaskˆforˆaˆdocumentˆdatedˆwithinˆtheˆlastˆ90ˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆutilityˆbill,ˆleaseˆorˆbankˆstatement.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆdon'tˆacceptˆExpiredˆIDs,ˆphotocopies,ˆstudentˆIDs,ˆorˆscreenshotsˆofˆanˆID.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="plan-plus">
TheˆPlusˆplanˆPlusˆcostsˆ$5.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆIt'sˆbuiltˆforˆpeopleˆwhoˆuseˆtheirˆcardˆaˆlotˆawayˆfromˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆorˆspendˆsomeˆtimeˆabroad,ˆandˆitˆaddsˆCushionˆandˆaˆhigherˆsavingsˆrate.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$5.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆfreeˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMs,ˆplusˆ3ˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawalsˆaˆmonth.ˆAfterˆthatˆit'sˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆ$25.00ˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ2.00%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆfee-freeˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$1,000ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆPlusˆincludesˆoutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆforˆ$35.00ˆeach.ˆYourˆcardˆisˆplastic,ˆlikeˆBasic.ˆUpgradeˆtoˆPremiumˆifˆyouˆwantˆtheˆmetalˆcard.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
